scene.head: tilt
scene.placeText: the great stone steps before the white palace of song on the harbour point of her world's capital at sunset — its huge sail-like shells tiled in glossy white and matte cream glowing gold above, a crowd seated along the broad steps below, the deep-blue harbour and the great arch shining beyond
scene.ownProp: a slender gold sceptre topped with a pearl-white shell shaped like a furled sail
scene.outfit: a songstress look fitted to her body — a strapless bodice of layered harbour-blue silk panels rippling like waves, a high-slit skirt of the same panels embroidered in silver with falling jacaranda blossoms, a standing collar of small white sail-shaped shells tiled in glossy white and cream behind her shoulders, strands of pearls and gold sandals
scene.scene: she is the prima songstress of the palace of song, standing at the top of the great steps before her evening song and raising her gold sceptre toward the last light as the crowd on the steps below falls quiet

prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Australian woman — the personification of Sydney — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Sydney as her world knows it — a city of a Western myth-world: carved stone and pale wood, glowing painted patterns, silk, lantern-light and drifting spirit lights, blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the moon or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: the great stone steps before the white palace of song on the harbour point of her world's capital at sunset — its huge sail-like shells tiled in glossy white and matte cream glowing gold above, a crowd seated along the broad steps below, the deep-blue harbour and the great arch shining beyond
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: a songstress look fitted to her body — a strapless bodice of layered harbour-blue silk panels rippling like waves, a high-slit skirt of the same panels embroidered in silver with falling jacaranda blossoms, a standing collar of small white sail-shaped shells tiled in glossy white and cream behind her shoulders, strands of pearls and gold sandals, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body in side profile, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly below, looking up at her.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a slender gold sceptre topped with a pearl-white shell shaped like a furled sail up beside her face; it is all she holds.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: an unposed in-between expression, mouth caught mid-shape, brows natural.
Scene note: she is the prima songstress of the palace of song, standing at the top of the great steps before her evening song and raising her gold sceptre toward the last light as the crowd on the steps below falls quiet

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles.
